verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Fedora Workstation targeting older hardware or extending device lifespan. The "performance mode" claim is a general power-profile feature and does not address older machines. The only community report about low-end hardware (fedora-comm-4) describes multi-minute freezes when RAM fills, and with no vendor claim to contradict, that cannot make this a dispute.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get better performance and extended device lifespan by installing the OS on older hardware
